title: Structure and Magnetic Properties of a New Lattice System of the Heterometallic Decanuclear Ce6Mn4 Aggregate

material_class.structural_family: decanuclear Ce6Mn4 mixed-valence cluster with a {Ce6O32} octahedral core encapsulated by four MnIII ions

synthesis.procedure: All reactions were carried out under aerobic conditions. A solution of Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.40 g, 1.00 mmol), pivalic acid (0.50 g, 5.00 mmol), and 2-aminoethanol (0.24 g, 1.00 mmol) in 10 ml of MeCN was prepared. Then Mn(OAc)2·4H2O (0.24 g, 1.00 mmol) in 10 ml of MeCN was added and the mixture was stirred and left to slowly evaporate. After 2–3 days, light brown crystals were collected by filtration, washed with MeCN, and air-dried.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution mixing followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: slow evaporation of the MeCN mixture; light brown crystals collected by filtration, washed with MeCN, and air-dried

properties.summary: Variable-temperature magnetic susceptibility of 1 is nearly constant from 300 K to 45 K (χMT = 3.98 to 3.91 cm3 K mol−1) then decreases exponentially to 2.0 K, consistent with weak MnIII–MnIII interactions and/or ZFS. No out-of-phase ac signal was observed, so the cluster is not an SMM. Fitting magnetization to an anisotropic model (independent Mn2 units, J1 = J2 ≈ 0) gave D = 2.13 cm−1 and g = 1.97; the conclusions describe weak antiferromagnetic interaction.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: solid-state, vacuum-dried microcrystalline sample; nearly constant from 300 K to 45 K; SQUID, 2–300 K

measurements.name: axial ZFS parameter D
measurements.conditions: PHI fit of magnetization with anisotropic model including DSz2 and Zeeman terms; J1 = J2 ≈ 0; magnetization measured 0–5 T

measurements.name: g-factor
measurements.conditions: same anisotropic-model fit of magnetization data
